about:
Kato Cable was founded in 2006 in Mankato, Minnesota, with a vision to create a different kind of cable assembly and wire harness company focused on employee success and innovation. The company operates from a 63,000-square-foot facility on a 12-acre campus at 99 Power Drive.

The company manufactures wire harnesses, cable assemblies, electro-mechanical assemblies, and battery cables. Its service portfolio includes wire marking, wire processing, automation, ultrasonic welding, braiding, overmolding, process control, and engineering control, supporting projects from design and prototyping through production and quality assurance.

Kato Cable serves original equipment manufacturers and distributors in power generation, commercial vehicle, powersports, medical, industrial, and agriculture markets. A distributor testimonial notes the company's strategic programs for product availability and timely delivery, while OEM customers cite collaborative communication and alignment on quality standards.

The company emphasizes its "Kato Cable Advantage," a holistic model that ties customer responsiveness and engineering value to investments in automation, industry-leading quality and on-time delivery metrics, and an employee culture that rewards problem-solving through Game Changer Awards. Community growth and volunteerism round out the stated philosophy.
